It’s a pity cause I really need something to improve my health…

title: Great for building someone else’s routine
body:
I am sure this app can be a godsend for anyone struggling with mental health and trying to create a good routine for themselves, which really is a powerful ally. Sadly this did not work for me, as I soon realised the app was not going to help me build my morning routine, but instead was going to build a routine for me. I personally don’t have breakfast in the morning for health reasons, I do not want to dance first thing in the morning to boost my serotonin levels; on the other side, I want to personalise my workout routines daily, I want to prepare work for my job in the morning, I want to read some pages of a book. I was hoping that this app would help me build and maintain a healthy routine, but it seems it will only help building their routine. Being able to build a routine (even if it’s imposed) is a great start to learn to build your own, but that is not what I was looking for.

Also way too much mystical self discovery stuff. Just give me a good schedule, cute reminders, a slick UI, and I’m sold.
